title: Sweet Potato Black Bean Burgers
description: These sweet potato black bean burgers rely on oats for binding and are flavored with Dijon mustard, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, and fresh ginger.
ingredients: 2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Poke sweet potato with a fork several times; place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until sweet potato can be easily pierced with a fork, 35 to 45 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board until cool enough to handle.
Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.

Peel sweet potato; place into a large bowl. Add black beans; mash with a whisk or fork. Add oats, onions, Dijon mustard, cumin, ginger, salt, and cinnamon; mix until well combined. Shape mixture into 6 patties with wet hands; place onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until cooked in the center and crisp on the outside, about 8 minutes per side.
